description: S.M.M. Hilmi v. Deputy Commissioner of Labour, Badulla S.M.M. Hilmi v. Deputy Commissioner of Labour, Badulla View More before Hon. H.C.J. Madawala, J
parties: S.M.M. Hilmi v. Deputy Commissioner of Labour, Badulla S.M.M. Hilmi v. Deputy Commissioner of Labour, Badulla View More
keywords: Provincial High Court appeal – Labour proceedings – Preliminary objection – Incorrect constitutional provision cited in petition – More importantly appeal lodged outside statutory 14-day period – High Court order dated 23.01.2014 and petition of appeal dated 21.02.2014 – Illness asserted but unsupported by documentation – Appeal clearly out of time – Preliminary objection upheld – Appeal dismissed in limine. L.T.B. Dehideniya J. agreed.
legistation: Constitution – Articles 138, 154P(3)(b) and 154P(6); applicable appellate provision requiring an appeal from Provincial High Court to be lodged within 14 days.
